import {createRequire} from 'node:module';import fs from 'node:fs';import zlib from 'node:zlib';
const requireApp=createRequire('/app/package.json');const {build}=await import(requireApp.resolve('vite'));
Object.assign(process.env,{VITE_LOCAL_PROXY:'false',VITE_CONVEX_URL:'https://different-bat-943.convex.cloud',VITE_CONVEX_SITE_URL:'https://different-bat-943.convex.site',VITE_SITE_URL:'https://salient-dev.rdxx.workers.dev'});
const results=[];
for(const variant of ['baseline','route-split-experiment']){
const analysis={variant};
await build({root:'/app',configFile:'/app/vite.config.ts',logLevel:'warn',build:{outDir:'/artifacts/performance-audit/'+variant,emptyOutDir:true,copyPublicDir:false},plugins:[{
name:'audit-only-route-split',enforce:'pre',transform(source,id){if(variant==='baseline'||!id.endsWith('/web/router.tsx'))return;for(const [path,names]of [['./password-recovery',['ForgotPassword','ResetPassword']],['./campaigns',['CampaignPage','CampaignsPage','JoinPage']],['./characters',['CharacterPage','CharactersPage']],['./wizard',['WizardPage']],['./progression',['ProgressionPage']],['./table',['TablePage']]]){const original=`import { ${names.join(', ')} } from '${path}';`;if(!source.includes(original))throw Error('Expected router import absent: '+path);source=source.replace(original,names.map(name=>`const ${name} = lazy(() => import('${path}').then(m => ({ default: m.${name} })));`).join('\n'));}return source;},generateBundle(_,bundle){analysis.chunks=Object.values(bundle).filter(x=>x.type==='chunk').map(x=>({file:x.fileName,entry:x.isEntry,raw:Buffer.byteLength(x.code),gzip:zlib.gzipSync(x.code).length,imports:x.imports,modules:Object.entries(x.modules).map(([id,m])=>({id:id.replace('/app/',''),bytes:m.renderedLength})).sort((a,b)=>b.bytes-a.bytes)}));}}]});results.push(analysis);fs.writeFileSync('/artifacts/performance-audit/bundle-analysis.json',JSON.stringify(results,null,2));console.log(JSON.stringify({variant,chunks:analysis.chunks.map(({modules,...x})=>x)}));}
